installs.note: 32q/4kv head_dim 128, 48 full-attention layers, 128 experts top-8; measured 2026-10-29

recommended.why: the GGUF install refuses TURBOSPARK_ROUTED_BATCH=1 (no GGUF routed batch kernel); an INT4-affine repack could take it

the 2026-10-29 sweep read s64 +27.9% and s32 +15.7% decode over 16 slots (3/3 clean pairs each); the cost is peak: 9.47 GiB at 64 against 2.84 at 16, so 16 stays the tight-memory choice and 64 the throughput default

held at barrier (unset): the GQA-shared kernel read +3.44% on qwen3moe, but the gqa arm's decode_digest (978256398f) differs from barrier's (6e355033dd) on every run and no moe_kl gate ran, and the CI's lower edge sits under the null floor; TURBOSPARK_ATTN_DECODE_KERNEL=gqa opts in until a moe_kl pass and a 6-pair rerun land

sweeps.description: expert cache slots at streamed residency
the GQA-shared decode kernel against the barrier default

findings.conditions: frozen rows; the llama.cpp cross-engine section compares the same GGUF

findings.workload: tslab sweep decode_attention: protocol medium-review, 64 decode, chunk 128, 16 slots streamed; 3 clean pairs, 0 dirty
findings.conditions: null floor 2.42% (record 1793261229311-16798-16, the governing floor); sweep record 1793261734050-29457-50; moe_kl; engagement verified (attn_decode_gqa on every candidate run, attn_decode_barrier on every default run); peaks ~7.26 GiB both arms
findings.note: leg 3 behind the llama-flow decode default flip, after llama.gqa-decode-mistral7b-2026-10-29 (+5.73%) and qwen2.gqa-decode-2026-10-29 (+3.93%); the CI's lower edge sits under the floor while the median clears it with 3/3 unanimous pairs

findings.workload: tslab sweep slots: protocol medium-review, 64 decode, streamed residency, 3 clean pairs per candidate, 0 dirty
findings.conditions: the verdict field is s64's (sweep best); s32's WIN is verdict 1793261574827-29457-30; sweep record 1793261574838-29457-32; bit_exact; null floor 2.42% (record 1793261229311-16798-16); the candidates' memory growth (+2.2 and +6.6 GiB) exceeds the 64 MiB allowance by design - a larger expert cache is the mechanism
findings.note: 128 experts top-8 at this install: 64 slots buys +27.9% decode for +6.6 GiB peak on a 17.3 GiB model; 16 slots stays the right answer for tight-memory hosts
